reasoning.evidence: Chunk padding uses checked_next_multiple_of(4); padded minus original cannot underflow and is0..3. Each padded chunk narrows only through u32::try_from. Total28 plus both raw lengths and paddings uses checked_add at every step, then checked u32 encoding. No signed32-bit cap, usize cast, wrap, truncation or fallback. Zero payload lengths admitted; actual serialized Value is nonempty JSON, zero BIN remains the existing two-chunk policy. Because total is four-aligned, the largest format-representable total is u32::MAX-3. On32-bit padding/total may return host Overflow; on64-bit out-of-format chunk/total returns Width with original usize and TryFromIntError.

The only emitted components are12-byte file header,8-byte JSON header, original JSON, its exact padding,8-byte BIN header, original bytes, exact BIN padding. Their sum is the admitted byte_length. Empty Vec reserves at least that many u8 elements with try_reserve_exact before append. Every prefix remains within reserved capacity; standard append/reserve capacity contracts and actual checked_rounding source were read. On32-bit a format-valid frame above native Vec isize addressability fails the native reserve with TryReserveError; no false claim everyu32 frame allocates. Allocation can also fail on64-bit. Serialization/earlier buffer construction allocations are not made globally fallible by this slice.

For admitted sizes, preserve serializer input Value, header magic/version/little-endian layout, JSON/BIN tag order and original payload bytes, JSON spaces and BIN zeros. Serde reference forwarding proves old&&Value and new&Value serialization delegation identical. Original buffer byteLength remains unpadded while BIN header is padded as before. Existing empty-BIN emission preserved despite specification SHOULD-omit guidance. Entire existing test module byte-identical to merged base; actual existing full roundtrip/skin fixture body inspected, no new tests/assertions and no execution.

No string-based classification. Serialize, Reserve and IO variants own their concrete errors; Width retains TryFromIntError and role/size. Overflow has a typed role because checked arithmetic supplies no native error object. Directory/write errors retain owned native PathBuf, including non-Unicode path identity. Public glb module exposes errors/result for downcasting while write, layout and PreparedGlb stay restricted. Caller Into converts GlbError to anyhow without formatting; actualanyhow From<E> preserves object/downcast. Layout is transparent, so Display/source forward to the inner layout error and its underlying cause; concrete GlbLayoutError remains stored in the Layout variant rather than guaranteed as a separate source-chain node.
